description: Trackwall windows (the main window and extra windows, ADR-49): the app's commands (daemon_connection, retry_daemon, open_window, window_shows_sessions, take_jump, open_link, and the app update commands check_update and install_update, ADR-53; the updater plugin is used from Rust) and core:default (events, the native context menu of view icons), no system plugin permissions.
